notes: Daily Rhythm & Recharge: citizens now use a simulated daily work/recharge rhythm. 06:00–20:00 remains the normal active cycle, 20:00–22:00 is wind-down, and 22:00–06:00 favors low-activity, safe return, maintenance, conversation, and repeated charging until usable battery capacity is full. Critical energy takes priority over autonomous productivity, while already-active physical jobs are not cancelled by the clock. Charging now respects degraded battery-health capacity and requires a charger at the citizen's actual named location. The Home world view also reflects dawn, daylight, dusk, and night as presentation-only lighting.
